deployments_detail.use: Embedding AI across underwriting, claims processing, financial advice and client engagement; appointed first Group Chief AI Officer

Sanlam Global Artificial Intelligence Fund uses an AI-supported risk management strategy designed to minimise capital loss and time in loss, applied to the fund's investment/portfolio management process. [Sanlam Asset Management]

AI Coach — a generative-AI digital financial coach (Sanlam Studios / Sanlam Fintech) that answers credit questions, reads and interprets clients' credit reports/scores, gives judgment-free guidance, and hands qualified leads to human advisers. Built on Voiceflow conversational-AI platform. In production since mid-2024. [Voiceflow]
deployments_detail.value: 45% of AI-generated offers convert to advisor conversations; 350+ active users daily with no marketing spend; ~3,000 business leads generated; conversion rates ~3x traditional methods

deployments_detail.use: AI Coach expansion beyond credit into healthcare/primary-care and gap-cover coaching — Sanlam Studios' digital financial coach extended to new specialisations to help clients understand and manage healthcare-related financial decisions. [Sanlam Studios (Voiceflow)]

AI-powered support knowledge base for Sanlam's client-facing web platform, featuring suggestive/predictive search, FAQ automation and analytics on customer search terms and article engagement, built by Realm Digital. [Realm Digital]

GitHub Copilot deployed to Sanlam's software engineers for code generation, code optimization, refactoring legacy code into modern languages, and automated unit-test data generation, alongside Azure DevOps. Sanlam described as the fastest and largest adopter of GitHub Copilot in South Africa. [Microsoft / GitHub (GitHub Copilot, Azure DevOps)]
deployments_detail.value: 20-30% time savings, up to 50% in some cases; one engineer reported feeling '5x more productive'

deployments_detail.use: Intelligent automation deployed across HR/human-capital operations — service management, payments, compliance activities and administrative HR functions — as part of the SAP-led people-transformation programme. [SAP]

Predictive people analytics via the maturing Talent Intelligence function — evolved from reports/dashboards to trend analysis, insights and predictive analytics, plus an AI-supported solution to measure productivity across Sanlam business entities. [SAP]

SAP Build Robotic Process Automation (RPA) — Sanlam concluded an SAP Build RPA implementation and completed a human-capital AI pilot as part of its people-empowerment/transformation programme. [SAP (SAP Build Process Automation)]
